justification: Inspected `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/encoder/HighLevelEncoder.java` and `core/src/main/java/com/google/zxing/datamatrix/DataMatrixWriter.java`. `HighLevelEncoder` is 484 lines with 16 methods, and it bundles multiple responsibilities in one class: 3 public `encodeHighLevel` overloads that set up encoders, handle macro headers, unlatching, and padding (lines 127-219), a large look-ahead/mode-selection implementation in `lookAheadTest`/`lookAheadTestIntern` (222-395), and separate helper utilities for character classification, minimum tracking, digit counting, and error formatting (398-482). `DataMatrixWriter` calls this class directly as the main encoding entry point, reinforcing that it is a broad orchestration class that could be split into smaller, more cohesive units.
